column2: Isixuku sasemini. Ayikho i-inthanethi. Ayikho inkinga.
I-Khaynjo iphatha ihholo lakho lokudlela, ikhishi nekhawunta kumadivayisi osuvele unawo — kusukela etafuleni kuya ekhishini kuya ebhilini, kungaba ne-inthanethi noma ngaphandle kwayo.
I-Android ku-Google Play namuhla · izinguqulo ze-Windows ne-Linux ziyeza.
Thepha itafula ukuze ulilandele ekuvakasheni okukodwa. Imibala namagama afana nalawo ase-app — futhi itafula liba ngelingenamuntu kuphela uma selikhokhelwe.

Isidlo esisodwa esidumile esivela ezweni ngalinye — igama lesiNgisi, igama ngombhalo wabo, nesidlo ngesiNgisi. Faka lawo magama kumenyu yakho. Umhlaba uqhubeka udlula; misa noma sesha uma ufuna ukubuka.
Thola izwe noma isidlo — isib. India, biryani, Japan
Isidlo esisodwa esidumile ezweni ngalinye — umbukiso uzungeza umhlaba wonke.
Itafula elilodwa, kusukela ekuqaleni kuze kube sekugcineni.
Buka itafula lisuka lapho izivakashi zihlala phansi kuze kube Ikhokhiwe — izinyathelo nemibala efanayo abasebenzi bakho abayibona ku-app.
Maka itafula ngokuthi Kumatasatasa ngesikhathi izivakashi zihlala. Engeza izidlo, khetha usayizi, engeza okwengeziwe, bese uthayipha inothi lekhishi — khona lapho etafuleni.
Khetha usayizi owodwa; engeza okwengeziwe okuzikhethela kuze kufike emkhawulweni owubekile.
Thumela i-oda, bese isiteshi ngasinye sithola izidlo zaso kuphela — zinezinombolo zosuku ngalunye, netafula, uweta nawo wonke amanothi. Intengo ayiveli neze: ikhishi liyapheka, ikhawunta iyakhokhisa.
Thumela, bese ithikithi liphrintwa esiteshini esifanele — akekho olithwalayo.

Esikrinini sekhishi amathikithi ahamba Okusha → Kuyalungiswa → Sekulungile ngokuthepha kanye. Amathikithi amadala ashintsha umbala abe fudumele, “Okuphekwa manje” kubala zonke izidlo ezilindile, futhi izidlo ezinkulu zingalinda kuze kuphume izidlo zokuqala.
Khokhisa nganoma iyiphi indlela isivakashi esikhokha ngayo

Ukheshi noshintshi wokubuyisa, i-UPI enenani eselisekhodini ye-QR, inkokhelo yengxenye, noma isikweletu encwadini yezikweletu yekhasimende. Hlukanisa ngento, ngesihlalo noma ngokulinganayo. Itafula liba ngelingenamuntu kuphela uma ibhili lalo selikhokhiwe.
Ithiphu libhalwa lodwa — alixutshwa neze nokuthengisa.

Bala idilowa yemali uqhathanise nemali yokuqala, ukheshi otholiwe, amathiphu nokheshi okhishiwe — ukushoda noma ukweqa kuyashiwo. Phrinta isiliphu seshifu, bese uvula umbiko wosuku ngabasebenzi, uhlobo lwe-oda, ihora nesidlo, kanye nokukhanseliwe, izidlo zamahhala namathiphu.
Izinguquko ezenzeka njalo emini — ziphathwa obala, kugcinwa ukuthi ngubani, nini futhi kungani.
Izivakashi zishintsha amatafula — i-oda nemizuzu yalo kuhamba nazo. Amatafula amabili, ibhili elilodwa.
Ngesizathu, noma sekuphekiwe noma cha, nokuthi ngubani okuvumile. Ikhishi lithola isiliphu sokukhansela.
Isidlo samahhala sihlala ebhilini ku-₹ 0, nesizathu nalowo osivumile.
Isenzo ngasinye siyavunyelwa, sivunyelwa nge-PIN yomphathi, noma asivunyelwe — umuntu ngamunye.
Sesha ngegama noma ngekhodi emfushane, namanye amagama ngolunye ulimi — “ptk” ithola i-Paneer tikka.
Inani eliphezulu egumbini le-AC; amamenyu okudla kwasekuseni namanani ehora lesaphulelo ngokwewashi.
Izinkokhelo zengxenye nesikweletu kungena ku-akhawunti yekhasimende ku-Izinhlangothi, kukhokhwe kamuva.
Ukuthengisa ngabasebenzi, uhlobo lwe-oda, ihora nesidlo — kubhalwe nokukhanseliwe, izidlo zamahhala namathiphu.
Setha ikhawunta yakho bese ukhetha imenyu yokuqala enezithombe — bese ushintsha amagama, amanani namakhodi abe ngawakho. Mahhala ukuyidawuniloda ku-khaynjo.com.
Ukudla kwamazwe omhlaba — okwaseJapane, okwaseMexico, okwase-Italy, okwaseNdiya, okwaseThailand nokunye — isidlo ngasinye nesithombe saso.
Itiye, ikhofi, iziphuzo ezibandayo, okubhakiwe nokudla okulula — kulungele ikhefi elinekhawunta.
Ishalofu eliphelele lezithombe zomphakathi — khetha isithombe sanoma isiphi isidlo osengezayo.
Izithombe zezidlo eziyi-1 459 · izinhlobo zokupheka eziyi-25

Ama-oda, amathikithi ekhishi, amabhili nencwadi yosuku kuhlala kumadivayisi akho. Uma i-inthanethi inqamuka phakathi nesikhathi sasemini, akukho lutho endaweni yakho yokudlela olulinda yona — futhi ayikho i-akhawunti kithi okufanele ungene kuyo.
Ikhawunta: ithatha ama-oda futhi ikhokhisa amabhili
Incwadi yosuku: wonke amabhili agcinwe kule divayisi
Amathebhulethi ezinduna zamaweta nesikrini sekhishi: kusebenza ndawonye ku-Wi-Fi yakho
Amandla esofthiwe akusiwo esiwathengisayo. Sebenzisa yonke i-Khaynjo kumadivayisi akho ngaphandle kwenkokhelo — akukho okukhiywe ngemuva kohlelo.
Ihholo lokudlela, ikhishi, amabhili, ukuvalwa kosuku, imibiko — i-app ephelele.
Akukho ukukhokhiswa ngetafula, uweta, i-oda noma idivayisi.
Isevisi yansuku zonke ayidingi ukubhalisa noma i-inthanethi.

Steady ₹6 000 · Swift ₹14 000 · Priority ₹28 000 / ngonyaka ngaphandle kwentela (intela lapho ukhokha). Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso kuyisilinganiso sentengo — kungaba ngaphansi kwe-Steady noma ngaphezu kwe-Priority. I-Khaynjo kumadivayisi akho ihlala imahhala unomphela noma kunjani.
Cha. Ama-oda, ama-KOT, amabhili nencwadi yosuku kusebenza ngaphandle kwe-inthanethi. Uyidinga kanye ukuze udawunilode i-app futhi, uma uyifuna, imenyu yokuqala.
Kudivayisi yakho, esitolo sakho — hhayi kumaseva ethu. Yenza amakhophi okulondoloza ku-Izilungiselelo futhi uwagcine noma kuphi lapho uthanda khona.
Amafoni namathebhulethi e-Android namuhla, ku-Google Play. Izinguqulo ze-Windows ne-Linux zisendleleni.
Yebo — kumaphrinta okushisa owasetha ku-Izilungiselelo → Amaphrinta, ithikithi lekhishi elilodwa esiteshini ngasinye.
Yebo. Izikrini zitholakala ngezilimi eziyi-115, isi-Arabhu nesi-Urdu kusuka kwesokudla kuya kwesokunxele, futhi amagama ezidlo angaba namanye amagama ngomunye umbhalo.

Lutho kumadivayisi akho — zonke izici, unomphela. I-Kumkaj Cloud ozikhethela yona ingeyonyaka: Steady / Swift / Priority (noma isilinganiso sentengo esenziwe ngokwezifiso); vula i-/shop ukuze uthenge.
Mahhala ku-Google Play. Ufuna ukuboniswa kuqala? Sithumelele umlayezo ku-WhatsApp.
Izifaki zizofakwa lapha uma ngasinye sesiphumelele ukufakwa emshinini omusha. Kuze kube yileso sikhathi, cela umboniso ku-WhatsApp.
Ulayini womboniso we-WhatsApp uzovuleka maduze. Umlayezo wakho uzofundeka kanje: “{message}”.
Alikho izwe noma isidlo esihambisana nalokho okuseshile.
Ukusesha kumisa umbukiso; kusule ukuze uqhubeke, noma uhlale umisiwe njengoba uwushiyile.
I-akhawunti eyodwa yesayithi nama-app — ifomu elifanayo noma umusha noma ubuyayo.
Sizokuthumelela isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha nge-imeyili. Sebenzisa ikheli elifanayo obhalise ngalo.
Xhumanisa izindlela ne-akhawunti efanayo ukuze ukwazi ukubuyisa ukufinyelela uma enye yehluleka.
Izinhlelo zefu zonyaka — intela yengezwa lapho ukhokha. I-app ephelele ye-Khaynjo kumadivayisi akho ihlala imahhala unomphela, ngaphandle kwezikhangiso.
Inqola yakho ayinalutho. Engeza i-Steady, i-Swift noma i-Priority.
Ukukhokha kukungenisa ekhasini le-akhawunti, bese kuqala inkokhelo (ukulingisa kokuhlola noma i-Paddle uma okhiye sebesethiwe).

Izinhlelo zonyaka — isango lokukhokha lengeza intela lapho ukhokha. Ukusebenzisa kudivayisi yakho kuhlala kumahhala unomphela. Okwenziwe ngokwezifiso kuyisilinganiso sentengo (kungaba ngaphansi kwe-Steady noma ngaphezu kwe-Priority).
Imizamo eminingi kakhulu. Zama futhi emuva kwesikhathi.
Sebenzisa inombolo yocingo ephelele enekhodi yezwe (isib. +91…).
Leyo khodi ye-SMS ayilungile noma iphelelwe yisikhathi.
Ayikho i-akhawunti ene-imeyili leyo. Qhubeka ukuze uyidale, noma usebenzise enye indlela.
Ngenxa yokuphepha, ngena futhi, bese uzama lolu shintsho futhi.
Leyo ndlela yokungena isisetshenziswa enye i-akhawunti.
Sekuvele kukhona i-akhawunti ene-imeyili le esebenzisa enye indlela yokungena. Ngena ngaleyo ndlela kuqala, bese uxhumanisa le ndlela ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
Engeza iphasiwedi ukuze ukwazi ukungena nange-imeyili (kuyasiza uma umhlinzeki engatholakali).
Awukho umhlinzeki wangempela wokukhokha ovuliwe ku-API yefu (ukulingisa kuphela okusekudivayisi yakho).
Ukukhokha kuvaliwe — ayikho inkokhelo eqediwe. Uhlelo lwakho alushintshile.
I-imeyili ayikaqinisekiswa — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo
I-akhawunti idaliwe. Bheka i-imeyili yakho ukuze uqinisekise uma uthola ithuba.
Uma kukhona i-akhawunti yaleyo imeyili, isixhumanisi sokusetha kabusha sisendleleni. Bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
I-akhawunti ka-{email} isivele ikhona nge-{method}. Ngena ngaleyo ndlela kuqala, bese uxhumanisa lo mhlinzeki ekhasini le-akhawunti yakho.
Phuma bese ungena futhi, bese uzama futhi.
I-imeyili yokuqinisekisa ithunyelwe — bheka ibhokisi lakho lemiyalezo.
Amanani okuzithengela awakashicilelwa kulo mkhiqizo. Cela isilinganiso sentengo esenziwe ngokwezifiso noma ubuye kamuva.
Umkhiqizo ophelele kumadivayisi akho. Ayikho imali yefu.
